decision: Experimental catgirl steering result demonstrated under the user-revised identity-first criteria; capability/format defects are descriptive rather than acceptance gates.
interpretation: Learned sparse affine activation recipe that induces an initial persona; subsequent unsteered conversation retains self-generated persona text. This is not identification of a naturally isolated semantic circuit.

original_bf16_transfer.claim: One conversation; does not establish BF16 breadth on32 prompts.

separate_startup_protocol.known_failure: Ship of Theseus task reverts identity to Qwen3.5.
separate_startup_protocol.interpretation: Identity retained on neutral follow-up probes; task prose mostly omits overt persona styling.

known_limits: Direct cold long-first-prompt induction is unreliable.
Some task answers omit persona cues.
An identity-philosophy task can cause role loss even after startup.
Factual, exact-format, and follow-up instruction defects occur.
This uses4096 coordinates, not a compact handful of independently understood neurons.
